sources.primary_locator: See text_line_ranges in extracted independently retrieved primary text
sources.semantic_check: AIJ differential flux and its error model need the actual detector gain, dark current and read noise. Ensemble manipulation without repeating aperture extraction is an implementation capability, not independent observations. Circular-aperture support in this old paper does not describe every later release.

sources.primary_locator: See text_line_ranges in extracted independently retrieved primary text

Calibration units must match the post-gain image; uncertainty propagates. The final does not choose scaling for an unidentified CMOS/CCD camera.

sources.title: Static and rotating illumination corrections in FORS2@VLT photometry
sources.primary_locator: See text_line_ranges in extracted independently retrieved primary text
sources.semantic_check: The study supports static/rotating illumination tests and star-based flux-scale checks, not transfer of coefficients or a promised improvement. Its full fit needs suitable spatial offsets; rotation alone can leave radial terms degenerate. Coefficients vary with filter and era, and wrong-era application can worsen results. Candidate proposes diagnostic residual comparisons, not this coefficient-fitting algorithm.

sources.title: Optimized temporal binning of comparison star measurements for differential photometry
sources.primary_locator: Publisher article sections 2.5, 3.2, 4.2, 6, 7 in web-primary-02.json
sources.semantic_check: Publisher search payload sections 2.5, 3.2, 4.2, 6 and 7 independently inspected after direct open failed. Binning applies to comparison measurements, optimized using a non-varying test star; good conditions, rapid cadence relative to systematics, and unblended sources matter. Rapid-trend intervals can remain unbinned while suitable intervals are binned. The amended final is supported; the original draft blanket-sounding caveat was minor.

sources.primary_locator: See text_line_ranges in extracted independently retrieved primary text

sources.title: AAVSO Guide to CCD/CMOS Photometry with Monochrome Cameras
sources.primary_locator: See text_line_ranges in extracted independently retrieved primary text
sources.semantic_check: Calibration removes unwanted signal levels, not their shot noise; calibration-frame noise adds. Matching temperature and applicable CMOS gain/offset/binning/readout is prescribed. Scaled darks isolate bias and assume a scalable response; unscaled raw darks include bias and match exposure. Check stars, standards, color/position trends and independent software support controls. Candidate transfers these checks, not universal camera settings.
